loop_note: Set by a sentence from Marco: 'vai' turns this true, 'fermati' turns it false. tools/loop.py go / stop do it.
open_phase_note: The highest phase the loop may work in without stopping. Only 'vai' at a gate (tools/loop.py go) raises it.
gate_width_note: How far the loop may run before it stops for Marco. 'task' stops after every task, 'phase' runs freely inside a product phase and stops at phase boundaries, 'run' stops only when it runs out of unblocked work. Marco changes it by saying so.
